title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：supply　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 supply 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the trader ① kept the supply that no partner in the market would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the week. The ② supply, meaning the stock itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; supply, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of supply in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ supply at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Supply, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the trader said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the supply was the whole of the matter, meaning the security and not the stock. The ⑥ supply, meaning the security and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; supply, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both stock and a security. He said the security is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ supply had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ supply of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of recording; supply, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ supply I remember is the supply recorded in the list, which closed in 1962 and is still recorded as the quietest in the market. ⑩ Supply, my mother said in 1964, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all supply, she said, is a security that has agreed to look like stock. She said the security was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 供应；供给（指集市里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 供应；供给（指那批供应本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the supply 保证这一批供应
D. n. 供应；供给（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 供应之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的供应之事）
F. n. 供应；供给（指货单里写到、被记载的那一批）
G. n. 供应、保障（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 保障（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the supply that no partner in the market would have recorded

the supply at the far stall

answers.why: keep the supply 意为“保证这一批供应”，1955 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯记载的一批供应做了一遍。
supply 意为“供应；供给”，指那批供应本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
supply 意为“供应；供给”，指集市里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
supply 意为“供应；供给”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
supply 意为“供应、保障”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这批保障就是那件事的全部。
supply 意为“保障”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批供应，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
supply 意为“供应；供给”，指货单里写到、被记载的那一批，到 1960 年这一批成了货单里的一行。
supply 意为“供应之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的供应之事是一处集市和三个星期的记载。
supply 意为“供应；供给”，我记得的是货单里记载过的那一批，1962 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一批。
supply 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，供应是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的供应。
